text:
An object P of mass 80g collides with another object Q of mass 40g.
After the collision, P and Q stick together and then travel on together.
Before the collision, P is travelling at a speed of 6.0m/s and Q is at rest.
What is the speed of P and Q after the collision?
A
2.0m/s
B
3.0m/s
C
4.0m/s
D
6.0m/s
subject: Physics
